englishDescription: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
chineseDescription: 在出生后的一段时间内，它会吸收背上种子里储存着的营养成长。

englishDescription: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
chineseDescription: 沐浴在阳光下越久，身体内会涌出越多力量，背上的花苞也会渐渐成长。

englishDescription: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
chineseDescription: 花朵散发出的迷人香味能安抚激动的心情，甚至消弭斗争。

englishDescription: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
chineseDescription: 生下来的时候，尾巴上就有火焰在燃烧。火焰熄灭时，它的生命也会结束。

englishDescription: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
chineseDescription: 如果它在战斗中亢奋起来，就会喷出灼热的火焰，把周围的东西烧得一干二净。

englishDescription: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
chineseDescription: 能用翅膀飞到距地面１４００米的高度。会吐出高温火焰。

englishDescription: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
chineseDescription: 当它遇到危险的时候，会将四肢收回龟壳里保护自己，同时从嘴里喷出水来。

englishDescription: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
chineseDescription: 会灵巧地摆动自己毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴，借此在水中保持平衡。

englishDescription: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.
chineseDescription: 从龟壳上的大炮里放出的喷射水流足以贯穿厚实的铁板。

englishDescription: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
chineseDescription: 别看它的脚很短，因为是吸盘，所以无论是斜坡还是墙壁都能轻松前进。

englishDescription: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
chineseDescription: 虽然有坚硬的外壳，因为壳里的身体很软，所以无法抵抗强力的攻击。

englishDescription: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
chineseDescription: 每天都忙着采集花蜜。习惯往腿部的细毛上涂满花蜜，然后带回巢穴里。

englishDescription: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
chineseDescription: 头上长有尖锐的针。它喜欢藏在森林或草丛里大量吞食树叶。

englishDescription: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
chineseDescription: 虽然几乎动也动不了，但是如果遇到了危险，有时似乎会竖起毒刺来反抗。

englishDescription: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
chineseDescription: 它会用双手和尾部的３根毒针反复刺伤敌人。

englishDescription: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.
chineseDescription: 性格沉着冷静，即使受到攻击也很少反击，只会朝对手扬起沙子保护自己。

englishDescription: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.
chineseDescription: 拥有超群的体力，而且飞翔范围广，经常飞到很远的地方寻找食物。

englishDescription: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
chineseDescription: 以２马赫的飞行速度来觅食。它巨大的爪子是非常令人惧怕的武器。

englishDescription: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
chineseDescription: 有两颗大门牙，见什么咬什么。只要看到１只小拉达出没，附近肯定还住着40只以上。

englishDescription: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
chineseDescription: 它的后脚上长着小蹼，以便它在水中游泳寻找食物。

englishDescription: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.
chineseDescription: 不擅长高空飞行。会以超高速在地盘里四处盘旋，以保护自己的地盘不被侵犯。

englishDescription: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.
chineseDescription: 很久以前就存在的宝可梦。哪怕只察觉到一丝危险，都会立即飞向高空。

englishDescription: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
chineseDescription: 身体会随着年龄增长不断变长。每到夜里，它会一圈圈地将身体缠绕在树枝上休息。

englishDescription: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.
chineseDescription: 根据研究证实，它腹部那可怕的纹路大约有６个种类已经得到确认。

englishDescription: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
chineseDescription: 皮卡丘们把尾巴贴在一起交换电流，其实是在互相打招呼。

englishDescription: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.
chineseDescription: 如果电囊空了，它就会直直地竖起尾巴，收集空气中的电流。

englishDescription: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
chineseDescription: 会在地上挖洞建造巢穴。挖洞时，即便遇到地里的坚硬岩石，也能用尖锐的爪子弄碎后继续挖进。

englishDescription: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
chineseDescription: 会将锐利的爪子钩在树上爬树。这是为了设法使树果掉落，分给等在树下的穿山鼠们。

englishDescription: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.
chineseDescription: 用坚硬的门牙咬碎树果吃。和雄性相比，角的尖端稍圆一些。

englishDescription: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
chineseDescription: 如果族群遇到了危险，会和伙伴们团结起来，施展出超音波大合唱。

englishDescription: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.
chineseDescription: 把孩子放在背上刺与刺的空隙里来哄它们。在这时绝对不会释放毒素。

englishDescription: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.
chineseDescription: 身材虽小，却性格勇敢。为了保护相好的雌性，会不顾生命果敢地战斗。

englishDescription: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.
chineseDescription: 神经敏感，动不动就打架。体内的肾上腺素一增加，毒素的浓度也会提高。

englishDescription: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.
chineseDescription: 以力量为傲的宝可梦。用自己的粗尾巴和连钻石都能击碎的角，豪爽地战斗。

englishDescription: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.
chineseDescription: 因可爱的举止和叫声而广受欢迎的宝可梦。不过很少被人发现。

englishDescription: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.
chineseDescription: 听觉灵敏，连１公里以外针落地的声音都听得见，因此平时会待在安静的地方。

englishDescription: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.
chineseDescription: 随着身体的成长，６根尾巴的毛发也会变得更漂亮。紧紧抱着它时能感到微微的温暖。

englishDescription: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.
chineseDescription: 聪明伶俐，但爱记仇。据说如果敢乱抓它的尾巴，它就会缠着你作祟１０００年。

englishDescription: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.
chineseDescription: 能够随意改变声音的波长，唱出听了绝对会犯困的神奇旋律。

englishDescription: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.
chineseDescription: 以自己细腻的体毛为傲。尤其是额头上的卷毛，更是有着天堂般的极致触感。

englishDescription: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.
chineseDescription: 栖息在晒不到阳光的洞窟里。到了早晨便会和同伴聚集起来，一边互相取暖一边睡觉。

englishDescription: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.
chineseDescription: 用小而灵活的脚走路。会悄悄接近正在睡觉的猎物，用尖牙咬住对方吸取血液。

englishDescription: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
chineseDescription: 白天会为躲避太阳而钻入凉爽的地下。会通过沐浴月光成长。

englishDescription: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
chineseDescription: 看似口水的东西其实是甜甜的蜜。非常黏稠，只要碰到就会一直黏住。

englishDescription: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
chineseDescription: 虽然花瓣越大，就能放出越多的花粉，但这样脑袋会变沉，容易疲倦。

englishDescription: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.
chineseDescription: 它会通过挖洞来从树根里吸取营养，但大部分营养都会被背上的蘑菇抢走。

englishDescription: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.
chineseDescription: 由于虫子的精华不断被吸走，在思考的似乎已经不是虫子，而是背上的蘑菇了。

englishDescription: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
chineseDescription: 在明亮的地方你便能发现它具有雷达功能的大眼其实是由许多个小眼睛聚集而成的。

englishDescription: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
chineseDescription: 如果不小心把它翅膀上的鳞粉沾到了身上，那不但会很难去除，更糟的是毒素也会从那里渗入。

englishDescription: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
chineseDescription: 在地下较浅的地方移动。被它挖掘过的地面会鼓起来，所以非常容易发现。

englishDescription: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.
chineseDescription: 三胞胎的地鼠，拥有能够挖掘到地下１００公里深的潜力。没人知道它在地下的部分究竟长成什么样子。

englishDescription: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.
chineseDescription: 为了不弄脏额头上的金币，会常常洗脸。和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。

englishDescription: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
chineseDescription: 拥有优雅高贵的身姿。与野蛮的喵头目性格不合，互相看不起对方。

englishDescription: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
chineseDescription: 头痛会随着压力逐渐累积而不断加剧。会用强大的念力击垮周围的一切。

englishDescription: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.
chineseDescription: 古老的故事中说，它会把污染河水的人类拖进水中带走。

englishDescription: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
chineseDescription: 身体轻盈，在树上生活。常因鸡毛蒜皮的小事发火而飞扑到周围的东西上。

englishDescription: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
chineseDescription: 只有在谁都不在身边的时候才不生气，但几乎没有人目击过这种情况。

englishDescription: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
chineseDescription: 性格忠诚。为了保护自己的训练家，会拼命地朝对手狂吠。

englishDescription: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
chineseDescription: 从古时候起就是俘获了众多人心的美丽宝可梦。能像飞一样轻巧地奔跑。

englishDescription: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
chineseDescription: 在水流湍急的河里，会把厚厚的嘴唇像吸盘那样紧紧吸在岩石上避免被冲走。

englishDescription: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.
chineseDescription: 流出的汗是黏滑的粘液状。即使被敌人捉住，也能哧溜一下滑走逃脱。

englishDescription: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.
chineseDescription: 除了游泳还擅长格斗技。能用经过锻炼的手臂使出豪迈强力的拳击。

englishDescription: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.
chineseDescription: 能够在睡梦中使出瞬间移动。据说它睡得越熟，就能移动到越遥远的地方。

englishDescription: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.
chineseDescription: 念力的威力大得惊人。会把精神力量储存在额头的星星里，以备进化之需。

englishDescription: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
chineseDescription: 会操纵强大的超能力。据说它双手握着的汤勺就是用那力量制造出来的。

englishDescription: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.
chineseDescription: 时时刻刻都充满力量。由于体力过剩而去举起岩石消磨时间，也因此变得更强。

englishDescription: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.
chineseDescription: 有着不会疲劳的强韧肉体。会去帮助人类完成例如搬运沉重行李之类的工作。

englishDescription: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.
chineseDescription: ４只手臂在思考之前就会反射性地行动，使出多发拳击。

englishDescription: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.
chineseDescription: 喜欢温度高，有一定湿度的地方。它会用身上的藤蔓抓小虫来吃。

englishDescription: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.
chineseDescription: 它在肚子饿的时候会吞掉周围会动的东西，分泌溶解液让其致命。

englishDescription: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.
chineseDescription: 用花蜜的香味引诱猎物。据说被它吞入嘴里的东西，只要1天就会溶解到连骨头都不剩。

englishDescription: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.
chineseDescription: 身体的大部分由水组成。在海中，会和海水混为一体，非常难以发现。

englishDescription: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.
chineseDescription: ８０根触手伸缩自如。会像撒网那样伸开触手抓住猎物并刺入毒针。

englishDescription: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
chineseDescription: 大多栖息于山路。由于不留神踩到它会使它大发雷霆，得多加小心。

englishDescription: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
chineseDescription: 常在山路上滚来滚去。滚动时从来不关心前面的路上都有什么。

englishDescription: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
chineseDescription: 刚蜕皮时浑身都白白的非常柔软，但是接触到空气之后会迅速变坚硬。

englishDescription: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
chineseDescription: 得到了小火马认可的人，在触摸它燃烧着的鬃毛时不会觉得烫手，真是不可思议。

englishDescription: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.
chineseDescription: 奔跑速度最快的烈焰马会成为首领，决定族群前往的地点和奔跑速度。

englishDescription: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 把尾巴泡在水里后会有甜味渗出，因此它会以尾巴为诱饵吸引宝可梦并将其钓起。

englishDescription: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
chineseDescription: 因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝离开后，它似乎就会变回呆呆兽。

englishDescription: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
chineseDescription: 靠吃电来维持生命。会一边从左右两边的组件放射电磁波一边在空中飞行。

englishDescription: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.
chineseDescription: 会不断释放很强的的磁力。在三合一磁怪接近时，大多数电脑都会发生异常情况。

englishDescription: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
chineseDescription: 用植物的茎来战斗。茎的挥舞方式存在着好几种不同的流派。

englishDescription: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.
chineseDescription: 羽毛较短所以不擅长飞行，但是拥有发达的双脚，能够以很快的速度奔跑。

englishDescription: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.
chineseDescription: 由嘟嘟的某个头分裂出的变种。以60千米的时速在草原上奔跑。

englishDescription: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.
chineseDescription: 喜欢天寒地冻的地方，就算零下10度也能愉快地游泳。

englishDescription: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
chineseDescription: 全身像雪一样白。十分耐寒，即使是在有浮冰的大海里也能很精神地游来游去。

englishDescription: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.
chineseDescription: 它由囤积的淤泥而形成。臭到让人无法碰触，凡是它走过的地方都寸草不生。

englishDescription: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
chineseDescription: 非常难闻！气味臭到让人窒息，但由于鼻子的退化，它自己完全闻不到味道。

englishDescription: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
chineseDescription: 坚硬的壳能反弹任何攻击。壳打开时，如果里面的部分受到攻击，就会变得很脆弱。

englishDescription: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
chineseDescription: 一旦它把壳闭上，无论是拥有什么样怪力的人都无法将其打开。

englishDescription: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.
chineseDescription: 能用稀薄气体状的身体潜入任何地方，但只要起风就会被吹跑。

englishDescription: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.
chineseDescription: 如果黑暗中空空如也，但你却感觉被什么盯上了，那么鬼斯通一定就在那里。

englishDescription: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
chineseDescription: 据说它会为了夺取山中遇难者的生命而从黑暗中出现。

englishDescription: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
chineseDescription: 弯曲扭动巨大结实的身体，以时速８０公里的猛烈劲头向前挖进。

englishDescription: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
chineseDescription: 如果你每晚与它一起睡觉，它偶尔会让你梦见它以前吃过的梦。

englishDescription: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
chineseDescription: 无意中遇到它的时候，如果不小心和它对上视线会很危险。它手里拿着的钟摆会让人睡着。

englishDescription: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
chineseDescription: 如果危险逼近，就会从嘴里吐出泡沫包裹全身，让身体看起来更大。

englishDescription: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
chineseDescription: 巨大的钳子破坏力十足，但是因为太过沉重，不战斗的时候就很碍事。

englishDescription: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
chineseDescription: 据说它与精灵球相似的外形其实是它的保护色，但它很容易自爆这一点也出人意料。

englishDescription: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
chineseDescription: 只要受到一点撞击，就会由于体内的电能溢出导致爆炸。

englishDescription: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.
chineseDescription: ６只不在一起就不安心。哪怕只是少了１只，都会马上想要逃跑。

englishDescription: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.
chineseDescription: ３个脑袋联合起来能使出强大的精神力量。天气变阴时动作会变得迟钝。

englishDescription: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
chineseDescription: 它头上戴着死去母亲的头骨。虽然也会因悲伤的梦境而哭泣，但每流一次泪，都会变得更加坚强。

englishDescription: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
chineseDescription: 进化后，与原本戴在头上的母亲头骨完全融为一体，而且性格也变得十分凶暴。

englishDescription: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
chineseDescription: 腿能自由地伸缩，即使离得很远，也能把对手踢飞。

englishDescription: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
chineseDescription: 打出的拳击甚至能劈开空气。但攻击３分钟后，它似乎就会想休息一下。

englishDescription: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.
chineseDescription: 主要以虫宝可梦为食。会用长长的舌头舔对手，等对手麻痹后将其整个吞下。

englishDescription: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
chineseDescription: 污浊的空气是它的美味大餐。据说在昔日的伽勒尔地区曾经存在着更多的瓦斯弹。

englishDescription: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.
chineseDescription: 虽然吸入空气的力量稍弱于伽勒尔的双弹瓦斯，制造出的毒素却更加强力。

englishDescription: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.
chineseDescription: 脑子里只能记住一件事。一旦开始猛冲，不管理由是什么都会很快感到无所谓而忘掉。

englishDescription: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.
chineseDescription: 全身被铠甲般的皮肤保护着。甚至能在２０００度的熔岩里生存。

englishDescription: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
chineseDescription: 原本动作迟缓。为了保护蛋不被抢走，逃跑的速度才变快了。

englishDescription: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.
chineseDescription: 藤蔓有着独特的香气。在伽勒尔的部分地区被当做香草使用。

englishDescription: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.
chineseDescription: 据记载，曾有没孩子的袋兽将遇难人类的小孩抚养长大。

englishDescription: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
chineseDescription: 会像跳舞一样在水中游动以制造漩涡。作为娱乐，会和伙伴比拼谁的漩涡更大。

englishDescription: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.
chineseDescription: 嘴巴虽然细，吸引力却很强。就算是比嘴巴还大的猎物，也能一瞬间吸进嘴里吃掉。

englishDescription: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
chineseDescription: 背鳍和尾鳍像肌肉那样发达。能够以５节的速度在水中游泳。

englishDescription: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
chineseDescription: 金鱼王之所以会用角挖穿河底的岩石来筑巢，是为了防止产下的卵被水流冲走。

englishDescription: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.
chineseDescription: 虽然会遭到鱼宝可梦的啄食，但身体即使被咬掉一块也能马上再生，所以完全不在意。

englishDescription: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.
chineseDescription: 会高速旋转着身体一边游泳一边吸收微小的浮游生物。

englishDescription: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
chineseDescription: 擅长表演默剧。用手指放出的波动制造墙壁，保护自己免于大多数攻击。

englishDescription: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
chineseDescription: 如果在森林中发现某个地方有大量树木被砍倒，就说明那里是飞天螳螂的领地。

englishDescription: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.
chineseDescription: 伽勒尔的迷唇姐外表靓丽，拥有纤细叫声的也不在少数，甚至有为其着迷的粉丝。

englishDescription: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.
chineseDescription: 暴风雨来临时，它们就会集结在高高的大树周围，耐心地等待落雷。

englishDescription: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.
chineseDescription: 全身时刻都在燃烧。大家认为它是引发火灾的原因之一，非常惧怕它。

englishDescription: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.
chineseDescription: 用角夹住猎物后，不是直接把对方切成两半，就是强行把对方扔飞。

englishDescription: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.
chineseDescription: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗性格暴躁，决不允许人类骑在自己的背上。

englishDescription: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.
chineseDescription: 又弱又可怜的宝可梦。在水流比较快的地方只能任凭自己被水冲走。

englishDescription: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.
chineseDescription: 就算是在狂风暴雨中，只要发狂的暴鲤龙出现，一切都会被它烧毁殆尽。

englishDescription: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
chineseDescription: 十分耐寒，不畏冰海。皮肤滑滑的，摸上去会有点凉。

englishDescription: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
chineseDescription: 当两只百变怪相遇的时候，为了能变成和对方相同的样子，它们动起来会比平常更加剧烈。

englishDescription: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
chineseDescription: 由于不稳定的遗传基因，蕴含着各种各样进化可能性的特殊宝可梦。

englishDescription: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 身体细胞的结构与水分子相似。它能和水融为一体，让别人无法看见它。

englishDescription: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
chineseDescription: 能够吸入空气中的负离子，有时会吐出大约有１００００伏特的高压电。

englishDescription: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
chineseDescription: 会将吸入的空气的一部分传送到自己体内的火囊里，制造出１７００度的火焰。

englishDescription: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.
chineseDescription: 近年来十分活跃于电脑空间。到处检查有没有可疑的数据。

englishDescription: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.
chineseDescription: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。依靠１０只脚来划水，在水中轻盈地游曳。

englishDescription: Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.
chineseDescription: 拥有足以咬碎岩石的锋利牙齿，但是能够袭击的猎物仅限触手可以伸展的范围之内。

englishDescription: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.
chineseDescription: 虽然存在已经灭绝的说法，但据说在一部分地区还是经常能见到它的身影。

englishDescription: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.
chineseDescription: 灭绝的原因尚不明确。曾经栖息在温暖的大海，是性格残暴的古代宝可梦。

englishDescription: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 长着锯子般的牙齿。甚至连钢属性宝可梦的皮肤都会被它的牙齿撕成碎片。

englishDescription: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.
chineseDescription: 拥有一个结实的胃，即使吃了发霉腐烂的东西，也完全不会吃坏肚子。

englishDescription: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.
chineseDescription: 拥有能够自由操纵冰的能力。据说它栖息在永久冻土的雪山。

englishDescription: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
chineseDescription: 传说的鸟宝可梦。据说只要它一摩擦翅膀，就会立刻发生落雷。

englishDescription: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.
chineseDescription: 相传它会用燃烧着的美丽翅膀照亮山道，救助在此遇险的人。

englishDescription: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.
chineseDescription: 长久以来被认为只存在于幻想之中。额头小小的突起是正在发育的角。

englishDescription: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.
chineseDescription: 把力量集中在尾巴的珠子上操纵天气。散发气场的样子非常神秘。

englishDescription: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.
chineseDescription: 被称为大海的化身。很多船都会把快龙的雕像设置在船头。

englishDescription: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
chineseDescription: 超梦的基因几乎和梦幻完全一样，但是大小和性格却迥异得让人吃惊。

englishDescription: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
chineseDescription: 用显微镜可以看到它身上极短极细且密集的体毛。
